scope: Ordinary modern basics, footer completeness, and art rim. Visual review, not a new whole-card score release.

sources.footer: Copyright wording, printed denominators and basic-land rarity letters read from the referenced ordinary English paper scans. Unknown sets do not inherit a copyright year or denominator.

normalization: Accepted v0.3.3 frame-only scan poses replayed without adjustment. Rejected and unavailable poses remain labeled; no text or art alignment is used to rescue them.
changes: Infer ordinary basic-land frame color from its subtype; explicit frameColors wins.
Use colored land title/type panels, land outer texture and tinted paper.
Draw the cached large basic mana glyph for matching mana-only bodies; preserve custom text and paragraph styles.
Render supplied collector numbers and verified legal defaults in the ordinary component and full-plate paths.
Make ordinary art apertures follow the calibrated frame width; paint a 0.75-pixel inner rim on all four sides.
limits: This is a completeness and geometry review, not a new set color calibration or a new whole-card accuracy report.
Frame and paper texture/color differences remain visible.
Vertical art/frame placement requires a wider frame calibration study; no card-specific crop or stretch is introduced.
